item.title: EplayerX 1.2.28
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 服务器首页沿用媒体库的排序设置，修改排序后会及时刷新。 - 媒体库支持删除百度网盘及受支持网络共享中的原始文件，并同步更新本地记录；也可清理未匹配条目的识别记录。 - 优化 AI 字幕的选择与恢复：可在字幕列表中直接选择，自动启用时尊重已有字幕与手动关闭选择。 - 改善画中画状态下的播放引擎切换、连续播放及兼容性恢复。 - 修复部分蓝光播放列表的解析问题。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Server Home now follows library sorting preferences and refreshes when the sort order changes. - Delete original files on Baidu Netdisk and supported network shares from the media library, with local records updated accordingly. Recognition records can also be cleared for unmatched entries. - Choose AI Subtitles directly from the subtitle list. Automatic activation now respects existing subtitles and manual Off selections. - Improved playback engine switching, episode transitions, and compatibility recovery while using Picture in Picture. - Fixed parsing of some Blu-ray playlists.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
